task: Bounded independent content review of RAW531-RAW547 proposals

scope.target_material: Only the owned GDT1042 native_groups.tsv projection and its existing report were used; no mixed source, other target text, image, sealed page, or new access was opened.
scope.registry_actions: Read-only navigation/search only. No ideas review, ledger, route, or active-state edits.

selection.role: Retain as a full-paragraph drafting scaffold for one explicit rival comparison, not as a selected semantic result or approved experiment.
selection.reason: It alone among the current proposals directly fits the newly corrected medical frame without requiring seasonal identities, and it names an actual truth-condition difference: fixed-state negation versus a corrective process. Its two form-pair anchors span the complete N/E/S/W scope instead of relying only on a single line or quadrant.

surface_anchors_from_owned_projection.dar_qodar: dar occurs at S.15 G002 in all three readings; qodar occurs at E.10 G002 in ZL3b/IT2a, while RF1b has the marked form qo@152;ar. Keep the RF reading distinct.
surface_anchors_from_owned_projection.daiin_qodaiin: daiin occurs at N.4 G005 and E.9 G001 in all three readings. qodaiin occurs at S.16 G002 and W.21 G005 in ZL3b/RF1b; IT2a has qodain at S.16 and qodaiin at W.21. Do not merge these written forms.
surface_anchors_from_owned_projection.scope: These anchors touch all four blocks, but do not by themselves fill the paragraphs. Alternate transcriptions are paths through one manuscript, not independent witnesses.

fixed_rivals.A_static_negation: Keep dar=HOT and daiin=MOIST as one expressly exploratory family; one typed qo=NOT operation yields NOT(HOT) and NOT(MOIST). Neither negation entails COLD or DRY.
fixed_rivals.B_corrective_process: Keep the same base values and form pairing, but read each qo-form as an intended correction of the named quality rather than a statement that the quality is absent. This requires written patient/state and action or goal support; a physician source context alone does not supply them.
fixed_rivals.full_paragraph_difference: At an explicitly fixed subject and time, HOT(x,t) and NOT(HOT(x,t)) cannot both be asserted. A correction reading can instead describe HOT(x,t) and a later aimed-for reduction at t+1. The same constraint repeats on the moisture pair. If target text never marks subject, time, or treatment, the two readings have no demonstrated target-level discriminator and remain unresolved.

smallest_meaningful_next_step.phase: Exploratory hand-authored rival construction only; no decoder, score, or new input.
smallest_meaningful_next_step.fixed_scope: All whole native groups in N=f85r2.2-6, E=7-11, S=12-17, W=18-23, separately for ZL3b, IT2a, RF1b.
procedure: Freeze the exact-form occurrence and marked-alternative table for dar, qodar/qo@152;ar, daiin, qodaiin, and qodain from the owned projection.

Draft every group of every block under both fixed rival semantics. Keep every additional word and construction visibly unknown or explicitly bound once; do not provide free prose that changes subjects or states to save a reading.

Bind all candidate qo-initial forms consistently if qo is asserted to be productive. There are many other qo-initial wholes in these blocks; explaining only qodar/qodaiin is not evidence for a general constructor. If they cannot remain unknown without conflict, reject the shared-q premise.
Hold GDT812's daiin=much/high-magnitude C0 family as an explicit, incompatible whole-form rival. Do not switch daiin between magnitude and moisture inside either new draft or silently inherit both.

Compare whether both full readings can state the same written subjects and relation across all blocks while preserving the alternate forms. Record no preference if either requires an unexpressed subject/time/action, token deletion, or variant alias.
smallest_meaningful_next_step.predeclared_stop: Stop at the draft comparison if the complete paragraphs cannot be authored with stable form values and explicit participant/time binding. No further semantic machinery or target access is warranted by an unresolved result.

underbinding_and_dependencies: The raw card assigns only two new whole-form meanings plus a shared qo operator and invented subject/state binders. Its example anchors cover a handful of the 107-109 group occurrences per reader; it is not a whole reading. Every remaining group and every use of a productive qo form still needs stable treatment.

No subject, body part, patient, time contrast, command, or correction predicate has been identified in these target spans. The source heading says that human nature is discussed according to four complexions; it does not identify HOT/MOIST target words, a treatment verb, or a patient-level state contrast.

The new doctor/complexion source frame is not a seasonal label. The physician and flask appear at a transition into four-complexion material in the Karlsruhe witness. This supports a broad medical setting only; no one-to-one season, age, complexion, figure, or paragraph ownership is licensed.

The moisture assignment for daiin conflicts with GDT812's fixed, low-confidence magnitude family. GDT812 explicitly retains incompatible whole-form families and does not promote either to dictionary status. Any next draft must compare these as incompatible candidates rather than retrofit or merge them.

GDT752 found no q-specific quality-versus-preparation direction rule in its tested exterior fields. That result does not logically disprove q=NOT, but it removes any claim that a q prefix split is already independently established.
GDT762 did not identify a liquid or specific medium; its contextual medical-role results do not supply HOT, MOIST, or NOT values for f85r2.
The RF marked qodar and IT qodain alternatives are substantive transcription differences. Alias normalization would erase the very compatibility issue the full-reader comparison must expose.
GDT884 excludes only its exact fixed STA-introduction morphism. Do not rerun that failed contract, repair its source spelling, or treat its UNSAT as a broader semantic verdict.
GDT1042 is an exhaustive surface census with no semantic binding. aiin is the only identical whole form across all four blocks; that recurrence is not a translation or a source-derived subject.

other_proposals.23_nourishment_requires_faculties: Defer: six guessed values occur in one rare E line, with no target organ/subject noun; necessary-versus-sufficient consequence cannot be tested elsewhere.
